articles.summary: Protillion Biosciences partnered with Merck in a deal worth up to $510M, using its Prot-MaP data-generation platform to produce training data for protein-design AI and quantitative protein library analysis.
articles.notes: AI biologics-discovery data partnership; directly relevant platform model

articles.title: Protagen Protein Services, BioAnalytix, and GeneWerk Combine to Form New CRO, ProtaGene
articles.summary: Three protein/biologics analytical services firms merged to form ProtaGene, a new CRO combining protein characterization, bioanalytical, and genomic services capabilities.
articles.notes: New protein/biologics characterization CRO formed via merger

articles.title: A Cell-Based Potency Assay for Determining the Relative Potency of Botulinum Neurotoxin A Preparations Using Manual and Semi-Automated Procedures
articles.summary: Characterization and qualification of the BoSapient cell-based potency assay demonstrates it is fit-for-purpose as a relative potency assay for BoNT/A drug products, in both manual and semi-automated formats.
articles.notes: Qualified CBPA format applicable to other toxin/biologic potency assays

articles.title: DynaKiller-Scan: Multimodal characterization of single-cell cytotoxic killing dynamics
articles.summary: A multimodal single-cell imaging and analysis platform characterizes the dynamics of cytotoxic killing, offering a higher-resolution alternative to bulk cell-based potency/reporter assays.
articles.notes: Single-cell resolution alternative to bulk cytotoxicity potency assays

articles.title: Quantitative modeling reveals sources of variability in cell-based potency assays
articles.summary: A quantitative modeling framework decomposes and statistically estimates the operational and biological sources of variability that affect cell-based bioassay reproducibility.
articles.notes: Statistical framework for bioassay variability/qualification

articles.title: BioTools Innovator 2026 Cohort Includes Top 30 Life Science Tools and Diagnostics Companies
articles.summary: The BioTools Innovator program named its 2026 cohort of 30 life-science tools and diagnostics companies, who will present alongside the MedTech Innovator cohorts at the Innovator Summit.
articles.notes: Cohort tracker for emerging life-science tools companies

articles.title: FDA Announces a 'Flexible Approach' on Chemistry, Manufacturing and Control for Cell and Gene Therapies
articles.summary: FDA/CBER announced flexibilities on CMC comparability data, process validation, and release specifications for cell and gene therapy BLAs, easing requirements for minor manufacturing changes.
articles.notes: Eases CMC/comparability burden for cell & gene therapy BLAs

articles.title: REGULATORY UPDATE: FDA Releases 2026 CBER Guidance Agenda
articles.summary: FDA/CBER published its 2026 guidance agenda outlining planned biologics guidance documents for the year, giving sponsors visibility into upcoming regulatory expectations.
articles.notes: Forward visibility into FDA's 2026 biologics guidance priorities

articles.title: Development of a recombinant adeno-associated virus vector for human T lymphocyte- and natural killer cell-targeted gene therapy
articles.summary: Researchers engineered a modular CD7-targeted rAAV vector with a nanobody-fused hybrid capsid, combining capsid retargeting with genome optimization for immune-cell gene therapy.
articles.notes: PMID 42124603; relevant to AAV retargeting strategies for cell therapy applications.

articles.title: Artificial intelligence-guided design of lipid nanoparticles for mRNA delivery
articles.summary: A review surveys how AI/ML methods are being applied to guide LNP formulation design and optimization for mRNA delivery.
articles.notes: PMID 41685167; Acta Pharm Sin B review, Epub 2025-11-27; crosses AI/ML and LNP delivery.

articles.title: Introducing a fusogenicity metric for lipid nanoparticle formulation
articles.summary: A new SAXS-based fusogenicity metric enables quantitative screening and optimization of LNP formulations for membrane fusion efficiency.
articles.notes: PMID 41846984; cross-listed bioRxiv preprint (2026.03.02.708638).

articles.title: Construction of a novel B7H3 VHH-Fc antibody with potent antitumor activity and NK/T cell activation
articles.summary: A newly engineered VHH-Fc nanobody-Fc fusion targeting B7H3 demonstrates potent tumor killing by activating both NK and T cells.
articles.notes: PMID 41812713; Protein Expr Purif, Epub 2026-03-10.

articles.title: De novo masking domains that gate TNF-family ligand assembly and activity
articles.summary: Computationally designed masking domains provide a new protein-engineering strategy to conditionally control TNF-family ligand assembly, boosting potency ~30-fold in trimeric format.
articles.notes: Conditional biologics design strategy; relevant to engineered protein reagents.

articles.title: A high-level programming language for generative biology with Proto
articles.summary: Arc Institute's Proto framework lets researchers compose AI models and bioinformatics tools into structured programs that design DNA, RNA, and protein sequences via a propose-score-refine loop.
articles.notes: From Brian Hie's lab (Arc Institute); open-source (github.com/evo-design/proto-language); posted within last 7 days.

articles.title: Reinforcement-guided generative protein language models enable de novo design of highly diverse AAV capsids
articles.summary: A protein language model fine-tuned with reinforcement learning generates AAV capsid sequences that are both highly novel and predicted to be functionally viable.
articles.notes: Date approximate (arXiv ID indicates March 2026, exact day unverified); crosses AI/ML and AAV capsid engineering.

articles.title: A Generative Neuro-Symbolic AI for Protein Sequence Design
articles.summary: EffieDes combines deep-learning generative models with symbolic reasoning to design orthogonal sequence pairs and a de novo nanobody with nanomolar affinity for an immune-evasive SARS-CoV-2 variant.
articles.notes: Novel hybrid neuro-symbolic approach to protein sequence design.

articles.title: Reading TEA leaves for de novo protein design
articles.summary: A structure-inspired 20-letter alphabet derived from protein language model embeddings enables fast, template-guided and unconditional de novo protein design.
articles.notes: New representation/algorithm for de novo design without known homologues.

articles.title: Biohub releases a world model of protein biology
articles.summary: Biohub released a large-scale "world model" of protein biology aimed at improving generative and predictive modeling of protein structure and function.
articles.notes: 33 days old at time of review; high strategic novelty but outside 7/14-day recency window.

articles.title: Infinimmune Enters Collaboration with Merck to Discover Novel Human Antibody Therapeutics
articles.summary: Merck struck a deal worth up to $838M with Infinimmune to use its Anthrobody platform and GLIMPSE antibody language model to discover human antibody therapeutics across multiple targets.
articles.notes: Major pharma validation of AI-driven human antibody discovery platforms.

articles.title: Nuclera Extends Series C Funding to $87M to Advance Antibody Engineering
articles.summary: Nuclera raised a $12M extension (total Series C $87M) to integrate antibody expression and binding validation into its eProtein Discovery benchtop protein production system.
articles.notes: Directly relevant to benchtop protein/antibody reagent production tools.

articles.title: Anthropic buys biotech startup Coefficient Bio in $400M deal: reports
articles.summary: Anthropic acquired stealth AI biotech startup Coefficient Bio, whose under-10-person team of former Genentech computational biologists built tools for AI-driven drug R&D planning and discovery.
articles.notes: Signals major AI labs moving into biotech-vertical tooling; relevant to competitive AI/biotech landscape.

articles.title: Antiverse Raises $9.3M Series A to Develop Antibodies for Undruggable Disease Targets
articles.summary: UK-based Antiverse raised a $9.3M Series A to expand its generative AI antibody design platform and signed a research agreement with the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation.
articles.notes: Direct competitor in generative antibody design for hard targets.

articles.title: Surveying the target tractability of cytokines with small molecules
articles.summary: A screening study identifies novel, first-in-class small-molecule cytokine inhibitors with single- to double-digit micromolar potency in reporter cellular bioassays.
articles.notes: Reporter-based potency characterization methodology relevant to bioassay development.

articles.title: High-Throughput FRET Affinity Screening Technique (HTFAST) For Cell-Free Expressed Binding Protein Characterization
articles.summary: HTFAST uses FRET between fluorescent-protein-fused binders and dye-labeled antigens to enable rapid, quantitative affinity (KD) measurement directly in crude cell-free expression reactions.
articles.notes: New high-throughput binder-characterization tool, skips purification step.

articles.title: High-throughput engineering of ligand-activated splicing ribozyme through domain insertion
articles.summary: Domain-insertion profiling combined with high-throughput screening maps the nucleotide-resolution landscape of aptamer insertion across ribozymes to identify sites supporting ligand-dependent control.
articles.notes: New high-throughput engineering/screening method for synthetic biology tools.

articles.title: FDA Issues Draft Guidance Further Streamlining Biosimilar Development
articles.summary: FDA's Revision 4 draft Q&A guidance removes the prior recommendation for a clinical PK study directly against the U.S.-licensed reference product, potentially cutting PK study costs by up to 50% (~$20M/program).
articles.notes: Comment period open until 2026-05-11; eases biosimilar comparator/PK requirements.
